$comment: Third-party skills used alongside this kit. They are DECLARED here, not vendored,
so upstream stays updatable and their licenses stay with their owners.
ai/scripts/install-external-skills.sh clones each source at its pinned ref into
'root' and symlinks the listed skills into each target's skills directory.
pi/metwally additionally discovers ~/.agents/skills natively, walking up from cwd.
'ref' pins the upstream revision. Bump it deliberately, then re-run the installer.
Upstream renames skills between revisions, so 'path' is recorded per skill and is
only valid for the pinned ref. Re-verify paths whenever you bump one.
COLLISION: mattpocock/skills also ships a 'caveman' skill. This kit has its own
authored caveman (ai/shared/skills/caveman) with different behaviour, so upstream's
is deliberately NOT listed here. Installing it would shadow yours.
